scenes.vo: Seventy one percent of British workers use AI their employer never approved. Two in three requests ask it to rework text people paste in: contracts, payslips, client letters. And every name in them rides out of the castle, to the model provider.

scenes.label: MuGuard
scenes.vo: MuGuard keeps them inside the walls. It hides the personal data before any AI sees it, then puts the real values back in the answer.

scenes.label: Quest 1: Drop a document
scenes.vo: Take a tenancy agreement. Our knight, a detector model trained and served through Mubit, reads it part by part, with rules for UK numbers.

scenes.label: Quest 2: Review
scenes.vo: In seconds, every name, address and number is struck out. In the PDF you download, the text beneath each box is truly gone.

scenes.label: Every part is a Mubit call
scenes.vo: Each part is its own Mubit call, with its request id.

scenes.label: Quest 3: Fix a miss
scenes.vo: Missed one? The landlord is our client, so I mark the name and hide it. Mubit trains the next version of the model on exactly that correction.

scenes.label: Quest 4: Approve
scenes.vo: Only once I approve may the document pass the gate.

scenes.label: Quest 5: Ask the AI
scenes.vo: Now I ask when the landlord may raise the rent. Claude sees only placeholders, and MuGuard restores the true names on my own machine.

scenes.label: What the AI received
scenes.vo: This is all the AI ever received. No names. No addresses. No account numbers.

scenes.label: Results
scenes.vo: Rules alone hide thirty eight percent of personal values, and not a single name. Our Mubit adapter passed ninety two percent of its held out test, against sixty seven for the base model.
